name: NovAI
description: Small OpenAI-compatible gateway that resells provider prices and hosts GLM Flash models for free.
overview: NovAI is an OpenAI-compatible gateway to roughly 110 models at provider prices with no platform fee. Zhipu's free Flash models are available at $0, limited to a few requests per minute until the first top-up, and new accounts get a small welcome credit. Terms are published in a machine-readable transparency file.
free_access: GLM-4.7 Flash and GLM-4.6V Flash at $0
notes: Free routes are limited to 5 requests/minute until the first top-up.
